verdict.rationale: Pylon's connector docs state that agents can access external tools/knowledge, and explicitly note that a Custom API tool is only needed 'if a system does not provide an MCP server,' implying that when a third-party system does expose an MCP server, Pylon agents can consume it directly. However, there is no detailed documentation of the connector configuration flow, supported MCP server examples, or authentication specifics for plugging in arbitrary MCP servers. missing for 10: dedicated docs/UI walkthrough for adding an MCP server as a connector, concrete examples of third-party MCP servers being used, independent/hands-on confirmation.
